# I am Jarl — Jarl Lyng

> Full Stack Designer & Developer, Copenhagen, Denmark

Jarl Lyng is a solo indie builder with 15+ years of experience in design strategy, UX/UI, interaction design, and frontend development. He designs, develops, and ships digital products — native iOS/macOS apps, web applications, and open-source tools.

## Projects
- WODrounds (iOS/watchOS/macOS/tvOS) — EMOM & interval timer for CrossFit, HIIT, Tabata: https://wodrounds.iamjarl.com
- Wean Nicotine (iOS) — Quit snus/nicotine gradually: https://weannicotine.iamjarl.com
- TrimrPix (macOS) — Image optimization with batch processing: https://trimrpix.iamjarl.com
- It's mono, yo! (macOS) — Batch WAV/AIFF stereo to mono for hardware samplers: https://itsmonoyo.iamjarl.com
- BeerTuner (Web) — Rate songs on a 0-11 beer scale: https://beertuner.iamjarl.com
- EmotionWave (Web) — Real-time global sentiment visualization: https://emotionwave.iamjarl.com
- Get to the Movie! (Web) — Arnold Schwarzenegger movie quiz: https://gettothemovie.iamjarl.com
- Made by Human (Web) — AI transparency badges: https://madebyhuman.iamjarl.com
- Nostromo UI (Web) — React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS component library: https://jarllyng.github.io/nostromo-ui/
- Running from Horses (Web) — Independent record label: https://runningfromhorses.com
- Anvil Workout (iOS) — Strength training app with offline tracking and progress charts: https://anvilworkout.iamjarl.com
- Little Rocket (Web) — Tiny Three.js browser game about flying through procedurally placed planets: https://littlerocket.iamjarl.com
- TrimrPix for iOS (iOS) — Compress photos on iPhone without creating duplicates: https://trimrpixforios.iamjarl.com
- Walkful (iOS) — Calm, private step and walking tracker: https://walkful.iamjarl.com
- BotLens (Chrome extension) — Open-source AI readability checker for websites: https://botlens.iamjarl.com
- PageLens (Chrome extension) — Carbon footprint estimator for web pages, with A–F Eco Score: https://pagelens.iamjarl.com
